help.output: Formats the final reply sent back.

panel.modelSubtitle: Choose a provider and model, then connect it with Pipedream.
panel.connectHint: Authorize your LLM account once — Stack32 never stores your API key. The model you picked above is sent on every Live request.
panel.modelChoiceHint: Pipedream only connects the account. Stack32 sends this model id on each request.
panel.apiKeyKeep: Leave blank to keep the current key
panel.apiKeyHint: Your key is encrypted and never shown in full again.
panel.agentReadOnlyHint: Goal, instructions and rules are set in Build. Here you can review what this agent is for.
panel.triggersIntro: Chat is always available. Turn on Schedule for a timer, or a tool trigger to start on an app event (email, Sheet, message…).
panel.triggersEnableHint: Shows the Schedule module in Structure. Open it to pick days and time.
panel.scheduleSubtitle: When the agent runs on its own.
panel.toolTriggerSubtitle: When an app event starts the agent.
panel.toolTriggerEnableHint: Pick the app and event below. After saving, open the Tool module to connect the account.
panel.toolTriggerIntro: Pick a Pipedream app, the event that should start the agent, then connect the account.
panel.toolTriggerRequired: Choose an app and an event.
panel.toolTriggerListenHint: While the agent is unpublished, Play wakes the agent for 10 minutes. A message or event starts the agent.
panel.toolTriggerListenError: Could not start listening. Check the connection and event.
panel.toolTriggerListenError_CONNECTION_REQUIR: Link the trigger app's account before you start listening.
panel.toolTriggerListenError_CONFIG_REQUIRED: The trigger is still missing a required setting. Open it and save one.
panel.toolTriggerListenError_TRIGGER_NOT_CONFI: Pick a trigger event and save it before listening.
panel.toolTriggerListenError_DEPLOY_FAILED: Pipedream refused the trigger. Check the settings you chose, then try again.
panel.toolTriggerPublishedHint: Published agent: event listening stays on around the clock.
panel.toolTriggerPlayHint: Puts Chat, Schedule and Trigger on standby for 10 minutes. A message or event starts the agent.
panel.triggersTimingIntro: Choose which days the agent runs and at what time.
panel.triggersHourlyHint: Adds a Schedule module and an automatic hourly run when scheduling is available.
panel.triggersSaveError: Could not save trigger settings. Try again.
panel.memorySubtitle: What the agent remembers from one message to the next.
panel.memoryIntro: Choose how conversation history and long-term memory work for this agent.
panel.memoryProviderStack32Hint: Zero setup — conversation history stays with this agent.
panel.memoryProviderExternalHint: Connect your own database with Pipedream for custom retention or isolation.
panel.memoryExternalAppHint: Pick the Pipedream app your agent will use to read and write memory.
panel.memoryExternalConnectHint: Authorize the app once. You configure the database yourself — Stack32 only stores the connection.
panel.memoryExternalInstructionsHint: Optional. Tell the agent how to use this database (tables, schema, when to read/write).
panel.memoryExternalInstructionsPlaceholder: e.g. Store user preferences in the preferences table. Never delete rows.
panel.memoryConversationHint: Keeps recent messages so the agent can follow the thread.
panel.memorySemanticHint: Stores useful facts across conversations when the agent decides to remember them.
panel.memorySaveError: Could not save memory settings. Try again.
panel.outputSubtitle: How the agent formats its reply.
panel.outputRoleBody: After the agent finishes thinking and using tools, this step shapes the final message you see in chat.
panel.outputEditHint: To change the output format, ask in Build — Stack32 will update the agent for you.
panel.chatWhatBody: Chat is the entry point: every message you type here starts a run of this agent.
panel.chatHow1: Your message is received and checked for safety.
panel.chatHow2: The AI agent reasons with its model, memory, and tools.
panel.chatHow3: A formatted reply is sent back through Output.
panel.chatNoConfig: Nothing to configure here — Chat is always available while this agent is a draft or published.
panel.errorFallback: Something went wrong during the last run.
panel.errorNoLogs: No event logs for this run.
panel.errorTryFixBusyHint: A fix is already running. Open Build to follow progress — do not send another request.
panel.errorTryFixHint: Sends the repair request to Stack32 and opens Build so you can watch the fix.
panel.waitingApprovalBody: This tool is connected. The yellow highlight means the agent paused before a sensitive action — approve or deny it in the chat.
panel.waitingConnectionBody: The agent needs an account connection before it can use this tool. Connect below, then continue in chat.
panel.toolConfigEmpty: Nothing else to set for this tool — the connection is enough.
panel.toolConfigAccountHint: If you have several accounts for this app, pick the one this agent should use.
panel.toolTriggerListenMissing: Open the trigger and choose {{fields}}, then start listening again.
panel.toolTriggerListenConnect: Link your {{app}} account before you start listening.
